patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Hive and Todoist share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Hive only if your buying job matches “Work management platform with free plan (≤10 members) and Teams from $12/user/mo annual — ” rather than Todoist's shape. Choose Todoist only if your buying job matches “Personal and team task manager with natural-language capture — Free; Pro from ~$6.25/user/” rather than Hive's shape. Workflow advantage: Hive leans work-management, team-collaboration-work; Todoist leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Hive and Todoist share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Hive is Work management platform with free plan (≤10 members) and Teams from $12/user/mo annual — strong monday.com peer.; Todoist is Personal and team task manager with natural-language capture — Free; Pro from ~$6.25/user/mo annual; Business ~$10..
- Workflow coverage skew: Hive-leaning work-management, team-collaboration-work vs Todoist-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Hive — Free and Starter cap members/projects at 10 — growth forces Teams; Todoist — Not a Work OS or portfolio tool.

Limitations — Hive: Free and Starter cap members/projects at 10 — growth forces Teams; Free storage (200MB) and AI credits (1k) are tight for active teams; Todoist: Not a Work OS or portfolio tool; Team features mainly on Business.

Poor-fit cases: Hive is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free and Starter cap members/projects at 10 — growth forces Teams · Todoist is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a Work OS or portfolio tool · Avoid Hive if you actually need Todoist's motion (Personal and team task manager with natural-language capture — Free; Pro from ~$)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
